senses.gloss: अस् [cf. Gk. ἐσ-τί; Lat. es-t; Goth. is-t; Lith. es-ti.]
आश् (आ- √ 1. अश्) P. (aor. 3. sg. -आ॑नट्, RV. i, 71, 8) to reach, obtain.
1. आस् ind. (an interjection implying joy, anger, menace, pain, affliction, recollection) Ah! Oh! &c.
आस् [cf. Gk. ἧ(σ)-μαι, ἧς-ται : Lat. âsa changed to âra; â-nus for âs-nus.]

√ 3. आस् (आ- 2. अस्) P. आस्यति, to throw upon, lay or put upon, TBr.; Kāṭh. : Ā. (Impv. 2. pl. आ॑स्यध्वम्) to cause to flow in, pour in RV. x, 30, 2; ŚBr. i;
to put or throw on for one's self, MaitrS.
4. आस् n. (?) mouth, face, (only in abl. and instr.) आस॑स् (with the prep. आ), from mouth to mouth, in close proximity, RV. vii, 99, 7
आसा॑ and आसया॑ (generally used as an adv.), before one's eyes
